overall_notes: The paper is clearly about NLG (radiology report generation) and uses both automatic metrics and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate but had some duplicates and non-normalized names. The paper focuses on factual completeness and consistency in radiology report generation, introducing novel rewards (fact_ENT, fact_ENTNLI) combined with BERTScore. Human evaluation was conducted by board-certified radiologists.
